description: Unit tests for Qpack header table implementations in QUIC, including encoder and decoder tables, testing insertion, eviction, capacity adjustments, and observer notifications.

classes.name: QpackHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Template base class for testing Qpack header tables (encoder and decoder).

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Test suite for Qpack encoder header table, including header field matching and eviction policies.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTableTest
classes.description: Test suite for Qpack decoder header table, including static/dynamic entry lookup and observer notifications.

classes.name: MockObserver
classes.description: Mock implementation of QpackDecoderHeaderTable::Observer for testing observer notifications.

methods.description: Asserts that header field matches expected criteria.

methods.name: ExpectNoMatch

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates maximum insert size without eviction for a given entry index.

methods.name: draining_index
